name: Moving Platform
description: A carrier that moves itself along a waypoint path and carries whatever stands on it. The hard part of a moving platform is not the path — it is ride detection: the rider must inherit the platform's displacement exactly, or feet slide and jumps go wrong. This component listens to movement.grounded / movement.leftGround so it knows when a body lands on or leaves it, but it deliberately does not own the rider's physics: gravity, collision, and the grounded fact itself stay with movement.physics_core and movement.ground_sensor. It also does not decide when to run. Loop mode covers self-driven carriers; anything condition-driven starts and stops by listening to world.switch_toggled, which world.switch_mechanism owns — a platform that grew its own lever logic would duplicate that component.

inputs.name: pathPoints
inputs.description: Ordered waypoints the platform travels through. Two points make a shuttle; three or more make a circuit. Vertical-only pairs give elevators.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Travel speed between waypoints in units per second. Constant speed, not eased — easing on a carrier reads as the floor slipping under the player.

inputs.name: loopMode
inputs.description: pingpong reverses at each end; cycle wraps from the last waypoint back to the first; once stops at the end until re-triggered.

inputs.name: waitAtEndpointsSeconds
inputs.description: Dwell time at each waypoint before moving again. A short dwell lets riders step on and off deliberately instead of fighting a floor that never stops.

inputs.name: requiresRider
inputs.description: When true, the platform only moves while someone is grounded on it — the classic ferry. When false it runs on loopMode alone.

inputs.name: transferVelocity
inputs.description: Whether a rider leaving the platform keeps its velocity. True makes jumping off a rising platform carry you higher; false is easier to read but feels like hitting a ceiling of glue.

outputs.name: isMoving
outputs.description: False during endpoint dwells and while waiting for a rider under requiresRider, not just when the path ends.
